## Service
Which service should OpenNexus connect to?

## What data?
What data would this connector provide to the digest / chat?

## Priority
How often would you use this?
- [ ] Daily (high priority)
- [ ] Weekly
- [ ] Occasionally

## API / Auth
Does the service have a public API? Any known auth requirements?

## Would you contribute it?
- [ ] Yes, I can help build this
- [ ] No, requesting for others to implement
